facts.situation: David and Susan Clarke are both retired. Their objectives and circumstances are unchanged since the last review. Both remain comfortable with risk profile 5 (balanced). They want to simplify their investments by closing their joint GIA and topping up their individual ISAs. Neither currently requires income from the portfolio. Both ISAs are already part-funded for the tax year. The joint GIA value was described as 'a little over £45,000' at the meeting; the recorded figure is approximate.

actions.action: Disinvest the joint Holloway GIA H-GIA-J in full.
actions.amount: Full value of the joint GIA

actions.action: Use the joint GIA proceeds to top up David's ISA H-ISA-D and Susan's ISA H-ISA-S, split equally between the two ISAs.
